title: Residency requirement.
bodyHtml:
[§327L-13]  Residency requirement.  Only requests made by residents of this State shall be granted under this chapter.  Factors demonstrating state residency include but are not limited to:

     (1)  Possession of a Hawaii driver's license or civil identification card;

     (2)  Registration to vote in Hawaii;

     (3)  Evidence that the patient owns or leases property in Hawaii; or

     (4)  Filing of a Hawaii tax return for the most recent tax year. [L 2018, c 2, pt of §3]
